# Mechanism studies (generated by market/mechanism.py; do not edit by hand)

Six-city replay of real Kalshi taker flow, test days Jun 1 - Aug 13, 2026. b and fee are each city's train-day choice for the forecast maker (data/results/adaptive_mm/test_summary.csv). Counterfactual estimate.

## Caveats

- Replay fills only real trades, at the taker's own price. A fixed-price quoter would also attract flow that did not happen on Kalshi; that flow is missing here.
- Feed delay is applied to the 1-minute archive; the true public feed timing is not observed.
- Settings are the forecast maker's train choice; curves are diagnostic, not re-tuned on test days.
